categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes descriptor import and rescan handling in src/wallet/rpc/backup.cpp and functional tests.
categories.rationale: Adds support for 'never' as a timestamp in importdescriptors to avoid mandatory rescans when importing descriptors without history. This addresses user issue #31263 by eliminating the two-hour window rescan imposed by 'now', providing a clear quality-of-life speedup for descriptor imports without posing safety or correctness concerns.
